title: objectql: a following amount whose parent code field is no longer served is refused as if the parent's code were blank (ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED message)
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTEivi2wogPpeo3xd5

Message-only loose end from #33628 (parked, seat ruling 6894796173). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade (proposed p3, A-lane objectql, message text only).

## What was measured (#33628, real engine at b00563826)

After `disablePackage(supplier)`, `uninstallPackage(supplier)`, or `enablePackage(extender)` leaves `suite_line.amount` following `invoice.currency_code` while `suite_invoice` no longer serves a `currency_code` field, the next child insert is refused `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` / 400 with:

> Insert on 'suite_line' was REFUSED: 'amount' holds an amount in its parent record's currency (currencyMode: 'record', following 'invoice.currency_code' through the master_detail 'invoice'), and the 'suite_invoice' record it names has a blank 'currency_code', or it names none. The row was not written. Write the parent's ISO 4217 code (for example 'USD') into 'suite_invoice.currency_code' first …

The remedy cannot be followed: `suite_invoice` has no `currency_code` field to write into. The message does not say the field is not served, and it does not point at the package lifecycle that removed it. A user who does what the message says gets a different error.

The text is built in `RecordCurrencyCodeRequiredError` (`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-currency-code.ts`). Its path branch has two cases: the `master_detail` names no parent object, or the parent's code is blank. It has no third case for "the parent object, as served, declares no such field".

## Ask

1. When the followed parent object, as served at the write, does not declare `path.code`, the refusal says so. For example: "'suite_invoice' does not serve a field 'currency_code' (a package that contributed it may be disabled or uninstalled); the amount has no code to follow until that field is served again, or leave 'amount' empty." Name the contributing package where the registry still knows it; otherwise drop the package clause.
2. Keep the code and status (`ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED` / 400) and the current text for a genuinely blank parent code. Message text only, so `Clause-②: no` is expected; the implementer confirms that by reading the ledger.
3. Pin: one test on the disable path (the #33628 probe shape: billing owns `suite_invoice`/`suite_line`, supplier extends `suite_invoice` with `currency_code`, disable supplier, then insert a child) that asserts the new clause.

Behaviour of the lifecycle doors themselves stays parked on #33628 (ruling D).

Dedupe words: `parent code field no longer served`, `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED disabled package`, `following amount refused blank parent code field missing`.
